qa_pairs.question: Where should User-Defined Function (UDF) source files be placed when preparing a Fluent job for submission to a cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: User-Defined Function (UDF) source files, such as `sampleudf.c`, should be placed in the same directory as your journal, case (`.cas`), and data (`.dat`) files before submitting a Fluent job to an Alliance cluster.

qa_pairs.question: When configuring a journal file for a Fluent job on a cluster, where should the commands for User-Defined Functions (UDFs) be inserted?
qa_pairs.answer: Commands for User-Defined Functions (UDFs) should be added to the journal file before the commands that read in the simulation's case (`.cas`) and data (`.dat`) files.

qa_pairs.question: Before uploading a Fluent case file with a User-Defined Function (UDF) to an Alliance cluster, what configuration check should users perform in the Fluent GUI?
qa_pairs.answer: Before uploading a case file to the cluster, users must ensure that neither the 'Interpreted UDFs' dialog box nor the 'UDF Library Manager' dialog box in the Fluent GUI are configured to use any UDF. This ensures that the journal file commands will be in full control of UDF usage when jobs are submitted.
